🎥🎬: Smile 2 (2024)

Global pop sensation Skye Riley is preparing for a major world tour when a terrifying encounter with a former acquaintance turns her life into a nightmare. Suddenly, she begins experiencing disturbing visions and horrifying events that seem impossible to explain, all while struggling to maintain her public image.

As the smiling faces around her become increasingly sinister, Skye realizes she is being hunted by a supernatural entity that feeds on trauma and spreads its curse through witnessing death. With her mental state deteriorating, she struggles to distinguish reality from hallucinations as the entity exploits her deepest fears and buried guilt.

With the pressure of fame closing in and the curse tightening its grip, Skye races to uncover a way to stop the horror before it completely consumes her. But escaping the entity may require her to confront the truth she has spent her entire life trying to avoid.
